items.name: Scrap Helmet
items.blurb: Beaten tin with a leather band. Better than a skull.

items.name: Canvas Cap
items.blurb: Sun-bleached and quiet. Nothing to rattle, nothing to protect you.

items.name: Hard Hat
items.blurb: Site-yellow plastic with a dented crown. Stops a falling brick, mostly.

items.name: Dust Hood
items.blurb: A heavy wool hood the colour of the road. Hard to hear, harder to spot.

items.name: Motorcycle Helmet
items.blurb: Full-face, scuffed visor, still holds. Cracked on the left, worn proud.

items.name: Riot Helmet
items.blurb: Polycarbonate faceplate and a neck guard. Somebody's last stand.

items.name: Dust Bandana
items.blurb: Knotted over the mouth. Keeps the worst of the spores out.

items.name: Dust Goggles
items.blurb: Amber lenses and a rubber seam. Squinting less helps you shoot straighter.

items.name: Half-Mask Respirator
items.blurb: Twin canisters and a fresh seal. A bloater's cloud is a bad day, not a death.

items.name: Gas Mask
items.blurb: Military issue with a hose and a wide round lens. You cannot aim through it well.

items.name: Patched Jacket
items.blurb: Canvas, rivets and a chest rig. Your colours on the shoulders.

items.name: Padded Vest
items.blurb: Quilted batting under canvas, and enough pockets to matter.

items.name: Leather Duster
items.blurb: Oiled hide to the knee. Sheds dust and spores; flaps like a flag when you run.

items.name: Plate Carrier
items.blurb: Ceramic front and back plates in an olive carrier. Slows you down; worth it.

items.name: Riot Armour
items.blurb: Shell, shoulders and forearm guards. Heavy as a promise, and about as loud.

items.name: Work Gloves
items.blurb: Stiff leather palms. A fist wearing these hits a little harder.

items.name: Fingerless Gloves
items.blurb: Bare fingertips for fast loading, wool everywhere else.

items.name: Padded Gauntlets
items.blurb: Knuckle plates over thick padding. Swing heavy things harder.

items.name: Tactical Gloves
items.blurb: Thin, tacky and black. Your hands stop shaking and the mags go in fast.

items.name: Work Trousers
items.blurb: Grey drill with a holster strap you never use.

items.name: Cargo Trousers
items.blurb: Pockets on pockets. Room for three more things.

items.name: Knee-Padded Trousers
items.blurb: Foam knees and a reinforced seat. Roofs and ledges hurt a lot less.

items.name: Plated Greaves
items.blurb: Steel shin guards and thigh plates over thick cloth. Clanks.

items.name: Worn Boots
items.blurb: Resoled twice. They know every road.

items.name: Rubber-Soled Sneakers
items.blurb: Gum soles. The dead hear you a lot less when you walk.

items.name: Steel-Toe Boots
items.blurb: Work boots with a steel cap. Land hard, kick harder, step loudly.

items.name: Trail Runners
items.blurb: Light, grippy, and nothing like the boots you started in.

items.name: Rucksack
items.blurb: Canvas pack with a bedroll lashed on top.

items.name: Courier Satchel
items.blurb: Strapped across the hip. Less room, but nothing swings and nothing rattles.

items.name: Army Duffel
items.blurb: A canvas sausage the length of your shoulders. Carries half a house and drags like it.

items.name: Frame Pack
items.blurb: An alloy frame that spreads the load. Pots and a kettle swing off it.

items.name: 9mm Pistol
items.blurb: Twelve rounds and a bad attitude. Keeps up with whatever you throw at it.

items.name: .38 Revolver
items.blurb: Six slow, heavy rounds. One in the chest settles most arguments, and it punches through plate.

items.name: Scrap SMG
items.blurb: Welded together from three other guns. Thirty rounds of noise, close in.

items.name: Sawn-Off Shotgun
items.blurb: Two barrels and no manners. Devastating at arm's length, useless past a hallway.

items.name: Pump Shotgun
items.blurb: Six shells and a proper stock. The sound alone clears a street.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.blurb: Bolt action and a worn scope. Reaches far, goes through armour, and the whole county hears it.

items.name: Hunting Knife
items.blurb: Short and quick. Barely makes a sound.

items.name: Baseball Bat
items.blurb: Ash, taped at the grip. One good swing folds a walker.

items.name: Machete
items.blurb: A long, flat, patient blade.

items.name: Fire Axe
items.blurb: Red head, hickory handle. Slow, and nothing stands up to it.

items.name: Wrench
items.blurb: Repairs and opens the field workbench next to your vehicle.

items.name: Crowbar
items.blurb: Strips tyres, engines and bodywork off wrecks.

items.name: Jerrycan
items.blurb: Siphon fuel and top up tanks. Slows you down a little when held.
